10. Accessibility

The floor, stated once. Every surface built on Instrument meets it, and the build checks what can be checked.

The Floor

  • WCAG 2.2 AA in both themes: 4.5 to 1 for text, and 3 to 1 for large text, for the edge of a control and for the focus ring.
  • The ratios are computed, not estimated. build.mjs resolves every token with the same color math a browser uses and measures every pairing the components use, for NCode's brand, for four tenant combinations and for six stress colors, in light and dark: the table. The build and npm test fail when one is below its requirement.
  • Meaning is never carried by color alone. A status has a lamp shape and a word. A boundary has an icon, a word and a fill. A switch shows an I or an O. An error has an icon and a message.
  • Keyboard focus is visible on every control, with one ring, lit on a screen, where it reaches 3 to 1 too.
  • prefers-reduced-motion stops all motion, and each animated part rests in a designed still state.
  • A table that becomes a list on a phone keeps its table roles in the markup, and its head stays available to assistive technology.
  • Every page runs under Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self': no inline styles, no data: addresses and no request to another origin. tools/shoot.mjs serves the specimens under that policy and fails on a violation.

Not measured as requirements, because they are decoration or exempt: the hairlines between parts, disabled text, and the unlit lamps of a selector. A word, a weight and a latched key carry those states.

A tenant's color is the one input no table can list. Products and tenants says how its pairings are held, and where CSS alone cannot hold them.

Browser Support

A browser from 2022 on renders everything. Four features are newer, and each has a fallback.

FeatureUsed forWithout it
light-dark(), relative colors, color-mix() (2024)The semantic colors and a tenant's derived colorstokens/tokens.css carries the same colors, computed by the build for NCode's brand, behind @supports not. Such a browser cannot derive a tenant's colors: the host sets them from tokens/derive.mjs
CSS masks, unprefixed (2023)BracesThe prefixed property is written too. With neither, a brace is a 2-pixel rule and a boundary plate shows its icon and words
:has() (2023)The wash behind the chosen row of a radio groupThe lit radio says it; a component adds the class is-selected
:focus-visible (2022)Showing the ring for the keyboard onlyThe ring shows on every focus
text-wrap: balance and prettyBetter line breaksOrdinary line breaks

Movement uses transform, never the separate translate and rotate properties. tools/browser-check.mjs checks, in a browser, that the static palette and the build's color math agree with what the browser computes.
